reviews.comment: I took her class this semester and I thought she was nice so I looked her up online and found her son's twitter..... very disturbing tweets.

I've never had a worse professor in my life. The fact that my tuition dollars are going to this "Dr." is pathetic . By the end of the semester I was annoyed by her every move and utterance. Seriously, do NOT take her class! I managed to get an A but it took a lot of work and frustration

I just needed this class for the credit and it was awful. SO many HARD assignments due online, and she was gone half the time on trips. I have no idea how I passed the tests, I didn't know what I was doing this entire semester in this class. She lectures the ENTIRE time, and it's so incredibly boring and hard not to skip (especially at 8 am).
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Way too much work for this class, her lack of feedback is horrible. She is more concerned with looking cool and being "hip" in her field than doing her job. She does not even teach geography. Just a waste of time all around. Do not take her for any class, way too much busywork that is ultimately not graded. Hard grader and waits until end to grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have ever had. Dr. Jepson gives A LOT of unnecessary homework that takes a lot of time to complete. She never gets back to you in a timely manner and also NEVER puts grades in until the last possible minute. Her voice is very monotoned and all she does is lecture over her powerpoint, so it makes staying awake hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst prof I ever took. She took half the semester to put one grade in. She had to curve the midterm because we all failed. She left for over a month to do research in london&mx. She does 'openTextbook' so she gives you about 50 websites, articles, and papers to read each week. 14 HARD assnmts due and it takes you about 5 hours to do one DON'T TAKE
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr Jepson is clearly very enthusiastic about what she teaches. But the way she lectures is not very enjoyable (especially at 8am). Don't take her if you just need the credit. Much more difficult class than it needs to be. She assigns way too many readings and most of them have nothing to do with the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Jepson for GEOG330 and she seems to have experience in her field but cannot effectively teach this class. She is so unorganized and such a slow grader. Test questions were "which is the most correct" type of questions and very confusing. She bases lectures of assigned readings that are long and boring. Prepare to put in some work.
I used a Q-drop for this class. That is all.

OK this is my far the worst professor Ive encountered at TAMU. Not that the material itself is hard but about the AMOUNT. shell give you 5 documentaries and numerous articles and textbooks to read yet NONE of it is tested. INSTEAD she makes test that have grammatical errors and are nothing that anyone has seen before. also the TA is no help!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The first exam was curved by 13 points bc no guidance was given on expectations for any tests or quizzes. Text book, articles, several documentaries, lectures, power points and an additional book. Told we should know all of it, changed the final just before it was passed out, ended up canceling the essay on the book ppl took time to prepare for.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Jepson is very knowledgeable and passionate but is often gone for her research and she takes forever to get grades unloaded. This class is a lot harder than it should be, even if you put in all the work and read all the assigned articles, you will still struggle on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She knows her stuff, which is fantastic, but can be hard to follow at times. She posts all powerpoints online. Tests are honestly pretty challenging, but she offers extra credit opportunities. There's a lot of reading & documentaries to watch. Interesting stuff tho.

She was unorganized, did major changes to the syllabus several times, and overall very hard to listen to in lecture. Three long novels on top of the textbooks you have to read, and several long documentaries. Average for her first exam was a 65, and she blamed the students for this. Didn't put in grades until very end of semester, a lot of work.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I learned so much in Dr. Jepson's class. Her class completely opened my eyes to how we think about environmental issues and the possible solutions to these issues. I would highly recommend this class! Her lectures are fast paced, and the tests are a little challenging, but if you pay attention in class and read, you will do well!

Dr. Jepson is very passionate about what she teaches. There's few assignments, but her class is a lot of work. You need to keep up with the readings and do the assignments well ahead of time. Exams are specific and require a lot of writing, so it's good to understand the material thoroughly. It's a tough class, but you learn a lot!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class wasn't a ton of work, but the exams are tough. Part essay/short-answer and part multiple choice. The write out is pretty easy, but the multiple choice section is pretty tough.  Lecture heavy but coincides with the textbook, so it's good to read. She's not a tough grader on the group project or the news project.

Read the textbook. A lot of test questions come from the reading material and lecture notes. Her lectures are entertaining and connects the the coursework as the semester goes on. Only took two test and had 6 homework assignments so be ready to have everything affect your grade.

She gives 6 assignments throughout the year, which are worth a good fraction of the final grade. Do not wait until the due date to do these, s they can take hours to finish. The test has a lot of specific questions that really test your understanding of the material. You can't rely on cramming or memorization. She is very passionate, but hard.

She offered many opportunities to understand the lectures more in depth. The test are tough, it is recommended to read the book. The power points(which she posted online) are helpful to re-read through. The homework is a bit long but not difficult to complete.  If you truly would put the work in, its an easy 3 credit hours.

Jepson is very passionate about geography. Her tests are difficult. My advice would be to read the chapters that correspond with the lectures and take clear notes. There are 6 homework assignments over the course of the semester and 4 are very long.  Attendance is mandatory and she reads straight off of the powerpoint slides.

She is very enthusiastic in her lectures but assigns insane amounts of reading and work for the class.  There is a giant group project, along with tons of reading outside of class.  There's only 2 exams and they are HARD.

Jepson is a really enthusiastic lecturer. Sometimes it's hard to pay attention just because of the nature of the class, but she is really passionate about what she does. Participation and attendance are required but the participation really helps gauge what is going to be on the tests. She makes an effort to make sure all material is understood.

Most of the class is spent drilling gender equality. She spends the entire lecture expounding on Top Hat Slides (Top Hat is a $20 glorified powerpoint you're required to have for the class, on top of the $200 textbook needed to do homework online.) The tests cover material from lecture, PP, homework and sometimes out of nowhere.  simply put: AVOID

Don't take this class if you are taking it for the credits it offers. The class average on both tests was under a 75. Tests are extremely specific. There are plenty of other classes that offer the same credit that are 10 times easier,
Took this class expecting an easy A, I'm going to end up with a C. Offers a lot of extra credit opportunities but the tests are insanely specific.

The lectures are really long, but she is passionate about what she teaches and a really cool lady!  She expects a lot more than you would initially think on the tests, so read the book thoroughly.  The homework is long and tedious but doesn't require much brain power, and is worth 13 of your grade so make sure to do well on these to bump grades up

Jepson is a great lecturer, and the assignments are easy but very tedious. I thought that the class was going to be and easy A but the tests require a lot of studying. My advice, try your best to get A's on all the homework to help even your grade out if you F up on the tests.

Take this class. It's interesting, but hard. Lectures are boring and she talks fast. Read the book and you'll do well on the exams. You have to keep up with the book. It's can't be read in one night before the exam. They aren't cumulative - mid-term and final. Go to lecture to know what she will emphasize on the test, but read the book for sure.

Miserable class. Assignments are easy, no brainpower needed there just time consuming. Lectures are endless and you won't get much out of it. Tests are hardly reflective of lecture and not at all like homework. You have to read the textbook thoroughly to pass. Figure that out before you take the first test.

The class was easy. There weren't many assignments and only two tests the whole semester that weren't cumulative. She uses big words so it can be hard to understand her but she's passionate about her job. Overall she's a good professor!

The assignments are the easiest things and dont help at all for tests. Read the textbook thoroughly or you won't pass. Her lectures are long and drag on forever. She's a very nice woman though and she tries to crack jokes which makes class a tiny bit more bearable.
Hated this class. If its required for you, wait it out and take it with someone else. She asks for way too much out of her students.

Great prof, super super easy class for 201, but don't underestimate the tests.  I made two A's and a B on the exams and somehow magically ended up with B in her class, as did another friend.  She obviously has strange ideas for how she wants the class grades to end up...

Loved this professor!! She made it interesting and easy to follow along. Her tests were difficult but definitely possible! she makes you work for your grade but it was fun stuff to learn and i HIGHLY suggest taking her if you can

The example test questions she asks in class often have mistakes or directly contradict exactly what she just said during the lecture, which is an indication of exactly how you'll feel when you crack open her first test.
Great prof. Study, do the work, and show up to class and you should get an A easily.
Do the homework, study the notes and you'll be fine.

Had no previous knowledge in the subject but I feel like I learned a lot. Completing the WileyPlus assignments are cruical, they take a lot of time! Don't wait till the last minute to do them! If you attend lectures and complete the online assignments you should do okay.
Easy class. Skipped more than half the class and still made a B. Make sure to do the Wileyplus HW which is a piece of cake and worth 60% of your overall grade.
She knows her material but you have to read the text, follow lecture, and just study.  My best advise is to just go to class and take notes.  She gives the powerpoints, but that is not enough.
Her tests are very hard, but she does give hints to test questions in class...so be sure and go to class. Also, she is very helpful when you go to her office.
No Comments
Her tests are hard!
She's a really nice lady and very smart.  Her tests were harder than they should have been considering the material.  But she curved very nicely so it all worked out.  I would recommend her.
